{{Hatnote|For the expansion, see [[Premiere Limited]].}}
'''Premiere''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>premiere</code>). Its card pool is [[Premiere]] (set id 1) and premium ids 101&ndash;103: the Premiere Introductory Two Player Game, the Jedi Pack and the Rebel Leader Pack.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /> It is the smallest of GEMP's Premiere cutoffs; the next is [[Premiere - A New Hope]].<ref name="gemp" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
